completedActions.description: DESIGN AGREED (Option B): SuttaPlayer-level factory switch. backgroundPlayback=false -> SpeechSynthesizerImpl (speak(), no disk); backgroundPlayback=true -> CachedSynthesizer (write()+cache). Steps: (1) Add synthesizerIsInjected:Bool flag to SuttaPlayer.init() to preserve test mock injection. (2) Add private makeSynthesizer()->ISpeechSynthesizer that checks Settings.shared.backgroundPlayback. (3) In play() and resetPlayer(), call makeSynthesizer() when !synthesizerIsInjected instead of hardcoded CachedSynthesizer(). (4) Remove fallback bandaid at CachedSynthesizer.swift:152-171 (diagnostic artifact; speak() also fails for Petra so bandaid is ineffective and mixes concerns). RATIONALE: Petra fails both write() AND speak() on iPad-on-Mac (Apple limitation). Goal is separation of concerns for independent diagnosability + in-field workaround for future Apple changes affecting one path but not the other.

summary: Premium voices (Petra, etc.) fail on MacOS 26.3 iPad-on-Mac mode. DIAGNOSED: both write() AND speak() fail -- Apple limitation. System can use Petra in native MacOS apps but not iPad-on-Mac compatibility mode. Fix is NOT to make Petra work but to: (1) separate speak() vs write() paths at SuttaPlayer level for independent diagnosability, (2) give users in-field workaround via backgroundPlayback toggle, (3) alert users when their voice is incompatible with the chosen path.
